description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to amend the Gaz. Ex. No. 896/2 of 07.11.1995 adding the Faculty of Technology to the Sabaragamuwa University
reasoning: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification that amends the schedule to an order under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It involves the addition of a new Faculty and Departments to the Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka through statutory authority. While it mentions a minister's name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail (only his title is given), and the primary purpose is regulatory - amending the legal framework governing university structures, which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or organizational changes.
